title: First M87 Event Horizon Telescope Results. IV. Imaging the Central Supermassive Black Hole
question: What does the 1.3 mm EHT 2017 data of M87 look like when imaged, and how robust are the ring diameter and asymmetry to the imaging method and parameters?

data.arrays: Phased ALMA (37 antennas as a 73 m telescope) as one station of the EHT VLBI array

evidence.quote: details of the 2017 observations, correlation, and calibration are given in EHT Collaboration et al. (2019c, hereafter Paper III).
